'''Runyips''' were herbivores native to [[Tran Mariel]].<ref name="RE" /> A species of similar appearance and grumpy temperament was native to the jungle moon of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], and was named "runyip" as well.<ref name="Wildlife" />

==Biology and appearance==
Runyips from Tran Mariel were known for the stubbornness, but were still commonly used a pack animals on frontier worlds. They possessed long ears and a long, bifurcated trunk to grab vegetation. Runyips were capable of carrying heavy loads (up to 250 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] in normal circumstances, and up to 500 in emergencies) and of traversing uneven terrain, with a top speed of 27 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per hour.<ref name="RE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel SpecForce]] troopers were also known to use them to carry equipment.

Yavin 4 runyips were a different species. They had claws on their toes which they used to dig for food, and made their home in holes. They had [[Color/Legends|brown]] and white fur, long antlers, and flexible lips. They rooted and fed on decomposing forest mulch and in the shallows of streams, rivers, and lakes. They did this by using their flexible lips and three clawed feet for sifting through dirt. They emitted loud grunts, squawks, squeals, and sighs as they fed. Their antlers were shed annually.<ref name="Wildlife" /> They could carry 130 to 150 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of passengers and cargo.<ref name="GG2" />

Natural predators of the Yavin 4 runyip include a number of species, including [[Piranha beetle/Legends|piranha beetles]] (in which its only escape is to dive underwater), as well as [[aquatic gundark]]s.<ref name="Wildlife" />
